subject: Request: SOC 2 artifacts + bridge letter and targeted MFA/log slices (Acadia Health)
messages:
From: Tom Keller <tom.keller@acadiahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 artifacts + targeted evidence request (audit window clarification)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this on. Acadia Health is kicking off our vendor audit for the 2026-11-01 to 2027-04-30 period and we need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report plus a bridge letter to cover the period between the report end date and our audit window. Our auditor (GRC Solutions) has also asked for a few targeted artifacts in addition to the report:

- MFA event slices for the audit window (successful and failed challenges) for human user accounts (production tenant), including timestamps, user id, event type, result, IP (if available), and request id.
- The most recent privileged access review (quarterly) and the attendant reviewer confirmations.
- A short cover letter explaining any redactions in the SOC 2 report.

I've attached our SIG questionnaire and the auditor contact. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide those log slices and the bridge letter? We prefer secure SFTP transfer for artifacts. Our internal deadline to hand materials to the auditor is 2027-04-24.

Procurement has also asked for an invoice/PO reference when artifacts are delivered: PO# AC-7782.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Keller
Vendor Governance, Acadia Health
procurement@acadiahealth.com
Attachment: SIG_Questionnaire_Acadia_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Tom Keller <tom.keller@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts + targeted evidence request (audit window clarification)

Hi Tom — thanks, we can support this.

Quick plan and questions:
- SOC 2 Type II: we'll provide the signed report (redactions applied to vendor-specific PII) and a short bridge letter covering the requested audit window. Ben will draft the bridge letter and share internally for review.
- MFA/log slices: security can produce targeted log exports for the requested date range. We typically deliver structured CSV slices with the fields you listed. We need confirmation whether you want tenant-level (all production orgs under your account) or specific customer/tenant IDs — please confirm.
- Privileged access review: we can export the last quarterly review artifact (CSV/PDF) including reviewer names and confirmations.

Delivery options: sftp upload to your endpoint is fine — please share the sftp host/creds out-of-band, or we can use a Redwood secure transfer link. We can have the bulk of artifacts ready within 3 business days after you confirm tenant scope.

We will also include a short cover letter for the auditor describing redaction rationale.

Next steps: please confirm the exact tenant scope and whether the auditor requires any additional KMS/key rotation evidence (some auditors request proof of KMS rotations).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Trust & Risk
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Keller <tom.keller@acadiahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acadiahealth.com>, GRC Solutions <soc2@grcsolutions.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts + targeted evidence request (audit window clarification)

Vanessa — thanks for the quick reply. Confirming scope:

- Audit window: 2026-11-01 through 2027-04-30 (inclusive).
- Tenant scope: Acadia Health production tenant only (tenant_id: ACADIA-PROD-01).
- MFA slices: we need both successful and failed human authentication events during business hours (08:00–18:00 local). If IP address is not present for some events, include request_id and device_id so we can correlate in our SIEM.
- Privileged access review: please include the last quarterly review artifact and any supporting evidence of follow-up actions for findings.

Auditor note: GRC would also like a brief note confirming whether Redwood performs KMS key rotation for service tokens (approximate last rotation date is sufficient). If you can include a single-line statement or an artifact showing the rotation event for Jan 2027, that would be helpful.

Delivery: sftp to sftp.acadiahealth.com — procurement will provide creds by separate email. PO# AC-7782 should be included in metadata.

Deadline: we still need everything to GRC by 2027-04-24 to meet their review window. Please escalate any blockers early.

Thanks — Tom
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T09:47:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SOC 2 artifacts + targeted evidence request (audit window clarification)

Team — technical plan below so we can hit Tom's 4/24 deadline.

MFA log slice plan:
- Query: SIEM query that pulls events for tenant_id = 'ACADIA-PROD-01' between 2026-11-01T00:00:00 and 2027-04-30T23:59:59 (UTC).
- Fields: timestamp, user_email, user_id, event_type (mfa_challenge, mfa_enroll, mfa_revoke), result (success/failure), device_id, ip_address, request_id, session_id.
- We'll produce two CSVs: mfa_events_success_ACADIA_20261101_20270430.csv and mfa_events_failed_ACADIA_20261101_20270430.csv.
- Add an HMAC signature file for each CSV to prove integrity (sha256-hmac).

Privileged access review:
- Export the last quarterly access_review.csv with columns (account, principal, role_before, role_after, reviewer, review_date, action_taken).
- Include any follow-up tickets (Jira keys) where applicable; redact internal ticket bodies if they contain unrelated PII.

KMS/key rotation proof:
- We can export a signed event showing the key rotation event for 2027-01-15 including key_id and rotation_timestamp. This will be a small JSONL event file (attached as rotation_event_20270115.jsonl).

Attachments I'll drop into the thread for internal reference: sample_log_schema.csv (shows column layout) and bridge_letter_template.docx (Ben, please draft using this template and include the redaction rationale paragraph).

I can prepare the artifacts and transfer to Acadia's SFTP once procurment sends creds. ETA: artifacts ready for upload by 2027-04-23 EOD Pacific.

- Stephanie
Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
Attachment references: sample_log_schema.csv (csv), bridge_letter_template.docx (docx)
From: GRC Solutions <soc2@grcsolutions.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Tom Keller <tom.keller@acadiahealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts delivery plan / minor KMS ask

Thanks for the plan — that should work. Two small requests before we finalize evidence intake:

1) For the KMS rotation proof, please include the rotation event ID and the signing certificate fingerprint (so we can validate signature chain). A single-line cover note in the bridge letter that references rotation_event_20270115.jsonl plus the fingerprint is fine.

2) When you upload to sftp.acadiahealth.com please add a top-level manifest.txt that lists delivered filenames, checksums (sha256), and PO# AC-7782. This helps our ingestion pipeline.

If you can deliver by 2027-04-23 EOD Pacific, we'll start our ingest and send any follow-up items quickly.

Regards,
GRC Audit Intake Team
GRC Solutions
soc2@grcsolutions.com
Attachment: request_intake_instructions.pdf (pdf)
